---
title: "Stations near the farm"
---

```{r}
source("_setup.R")
sites <- read_fig_csv("station_map_data.csv")
```

{{< include _sample_warning.qmd >}}

The farm's planned position is marked in red. The 15 km circles are an **estimate** of
detection range on open terrain; real range depends on the tag, antenna height and
terrain, and will be measured in a range test after installation.

```{r}
iframe("figures/station_map.html", 600)
```

## Sites within 150 km

```{r}
sites %>%
  transmute(Station = station, Status = status, `Distance (km)` = round(dist_km),
            Deployments = n_deployments, `First active` = substr(first_active, 1, 10),
            `Last active` = ifelse(is.na(last_active) | last_active == "", "", substr(last_active, 1, 10))) %>%
  arrange(Status, `Distance (km)`) %>%
  kable()
```

"Active" means the deployment has not been closed on motus.org, which is the best
available signal that a station is still running.
